asset.name: UI play
asset.originalUserRequest: Build a polished Roblox main menu titled AURORA. Features: Play, Settings, Credits. Settings opens a panel with Music on/off toggle and Volume slider. Credits opens a small panel. Both panels have Close. Desktop and mobile. Rich glossy cyan/cobalt artwork with thick navy edges, warm gold highlights, ornamental corner details and a title plate. Use Gemini-generated matching skins and icons: button skins, panel skin, slider track and handle, toggle on/off pieces and distinct play/settings/credits/close icons. Keep text live and readable. Create only these features; no shop, rewards, currency, ranks or invented game systems. Play closes the menu and fires a clearly named local hook for game integration. Coherent hover and press animation. Native background layout with restrained decoration. Panels must open and close in the actual controller.
asset.promptSummary:
Create a production-quality Roblox game UI asset sheet at 4K resolution. Art direction: Premium fantasy-tech main menu centered on a glossy title plate and a single dominant Play call-to-action, using a controlled cyan-to-cobalt palette with thick navy framing and restrained gold edge highlights. Artwork should feel polished and dimensional without clutter: Gemini-generated 9-slice skins for primary buttons and panels, matching ornamental corner pieces used sparingly, and a clean native darkened background field so the interface reads immediately. Text remains fully live, bright, and crisp over painted surfaces. The Settings panel uses the same ornate family but in a practical layout with a readable music toggle row and a distinct volume slider track/handle set. The Credits panel is smaller and quieter, visually subordinate to the main menu. Overall mood is premium, glossy, readable, and game-ready rather than overloaded..

Outlines: Thick navy outer strokes on painted controls and panels, with selective inner gold highlight lines on title plate and primary button. Native text itself is not outlined heavily; emphasis comes from contrast, weight, and controlled shadow. Use UIStroke for native supporting frames where artwork is absent..
Exactly 4 columns and 2 rows, 6 separate assets, in reading order. Equal invisible cells. Every asset has equal visual importance: no hero item, merged cells, duplicate asset, extra variant or collage layout. Never draw grid lines, labels or slot numbers. Leave unused cells empty.
Cell 1: icon, play icon. Gemini-generated icon family for play, settings, credits, and close using front-facing glossy symbols with cyan/cobalt enamel fills, navy edging, and restrained gold glints to match painted controls.. Preserve natural proportions and all silhouette details.
Cell 2: control_artwork, One isolated compact toggle thumb only; no housing, track or adjacent state.. Preserve natural proportions and all silhouette details.
Cell 3: control_artwork, One isolated compact slider handle only; no track or housing.. Preserve natural proportions and all silhouette details.
Cell 4: icon, credits icon. Gemini-generated icon family for play, settings, credits, and close using front-facing glossy symbols with cyan/cobalt enamel fills, navy edging, and restrained gold glints to match painted controls.. Preserve natural proportions and all silhouette details.
Cell 5: icon, close icon. Gemini-generated icon family for play, settings, credits, and close using front-facing glossy symbols with cyan/cobalt enamel fills, navy edging, and restrained gold glints to match painted controls.. Preserve natural proportions and all silhouette details.
Cell 6: icon, settings icon. Gemini-generated icon family for play, settings, credits, and close using front-facing glossy symbols with cyan/cobalt enamel fills, navy edging, and restrained gold glints to match painted controls.. Preserve natural proportions and all silhouette details.
Every asset centered in its cell with at least 8 percent empty margin on EVERY side. Everything outside each asset, including enclosed holes, must be perfectly uniform #00FF00. asset.name: UI settings
asset.originalUserRequest: Build a polished Roblox main menu titled AURORA. Features: Play, Settings, Credits. Settings opens a panel with Music on/off toggle and Volume slider. Credits opens a small panel. Both panels have Close. Desktop and mobile. Rich glossy cyan/cobalt artwork with thick navy edges, warm gold highlights, ornamental corner details and a title plate. Use Gemini-generated matching skins and icons: button skins, panel skin, slider track and handle, toggle on/off pieces and distinct play/settings/credits/close icons. Keep text live and readable. Create only these features; no shop, rewards, currency, ranks or invented game systems. Play closes the menu and fires a clearly named local hook for game integration. Coherent hover and press animation. Native background layout with restrained decoration. Panels must open and close in the actual controller.
